sources.locator: "Prelude to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine", revision 1370705034, lead and the closing narrative

explanation: The article is the build-up and it ends on the invasion: "On the morning of 24 February, Putin announced that Russia was initiating a \"special military operation\" in the Donbas, and launched a full-scale invasion into Ukraine", after a year in which "Russia had assembled 83 battalion tactical groups, estimated to be 70 percent of its combat capabilities, for a full-scale invasion of Ukraine". The item says the same thing as a pointer, Q110116635 P156. The type is precondition-of rather than caused, because the article is an account of what was in place before the decision. It does not argue that the build-up compelled it. The two records are siblings under russo-ukrainian-war, and this is the edge the filing cannot make.
